description: This file defines the IMembershipService interface used within the Orleans.Runtime namespace, along with the IndirectProbeResponse struct. It specifies methods for membership change notifications, liveness probing, and indirect probing responses, which are crucial in a distributed system's membership management.

classes.name: IndirectProbeResponse
classes.description: A serializable, immutable struct representing the result of an indirect node probe, including health score, success status, response time, and failure message.

methods.name: MembershipChangeNotification
methods.description: Notifies about changes in the membership table with a snapshot parameter.

methods.name: Ping
methods.description: Sends a ping request to test the liveness of a silo, identified by a unique ping number.

methods.name: ProbeIndirectly
methods.description: Performs an indirect probe of a target silo, returning a response indicating success, health, and timing details.
